name: SCCP Manager
changelog:
*17.1.24* Fix FreePBX visual voicemail service bootstrap and republish without a phone reset.\n*17.1.23* Visual voicemail, per-phone mailbox, auto-answer playback with recorded Caller ID.\n*17.1.22* Global phone menus and optional internal service provisioning.\n*17.1.21* Editable Cisco phone directory titles, prompts and menu labels, saved and published immediately.\n*17.1.20* Fix ringtone catalog filename to lowercase ringlist.xml.sgn as requested by Cisco 7945G.\n*17.1.19* Fix signed Cisco wallpaper header filename to the TFTP-relative path.\n*17.1.18* Sign Cisco wallpaper List.xml.sgn and PNG assets with existing TFTP certificate.\n*17.1.17* Native FreePBX phone content UI, no duplicate call-history entries, automatic wallpaper provisioning and TFTP root mismatch detection.\n*17.1.16* Fix content publishing under AMPWEBROOT, include 7945G wallpaper enable configuration, ensure managed directory URLs and add diagnostics.\n*17.1.15* Phone Content menu: address book, wallpaper gallery and ringtone uploads, with automatic directory/service URLs and Cisco TFTP index generation.\n*17.1.14* Fix signing wrong configuration from TFTP root when the latest phone XML is in settings; publish both files together and preserve ITL.\n*17.1.13* Automatically build ocserv 1.3.0 on Debian 12 when the installed VPN server lacks Cisco SVC support. Migrate existing managed VPN service without resetting accounts or certificates.\n*17.1.12* Enable the Cisco SVC IP phone compatibility mode required for /svc VPN login.\n*17.1.11* Show VPN account list, account password updates/deletion, live connected VPN phones, and recent authentication activity.\n*17.1.10* Fix clean installation erroneously treating a missing SCCP driver as an AMI failure.\n*17.1.9* Bootstrap chan-sccp automatically after a true clean uninstall.\n*17.1.8* Streamline VPN/Signing GUI with one Server Config tab and automatic PBX IP detection.\n*17.1.7* Fix unexpected FreePBX Firewall activation on VPN save; save rules without starting or restarting firewall.\n*17.1.6* FreePBX Firewall integration for managed VPN services and client pool.
*17.1.6* Adds automated VPN server installation and configuration from FreePBX.
*17.1.4* Integrate global and per-device VPN/signing settings into SCCP Manager.\n*17.1.4* Restore SCCP runtime compatibility fixes and packaged regression checks.
*17.1.4* Fix AMI realtime status undefined realm and invalid CallManager/SRST address input.
*17.1.4* Development preview: built-in Cisco VPN profiles, signing, managed ocserv integration. No upstream PR.
*17.1.1* Bundles chan-sccp 4.4.1; source build of the driver uses a plain ./configure
*17.1.0* Security and correctness review applied; saved-but-unused settings now take effect; no phone credentials in templates; useRedialMenu default on; bundles chan-sccp 4.4.0
*17.0.1* Adapted for Asterisk 23 / FreePBX 17
*15.0.1* Own fork, Asterisk 20 / FreePBX 16 support
*14.5.0.4* Preserve softkeys across installs. Fix truncated values
*14.5.0.3* Fix issue 32
*14.4.0.5* Fix issue 59
*14.4.0.1* Fix regression in SQL not compatible with MariaDb 5
*14.4.0.1* Upgrade installer to prevent data loss when run
*14.3.0.30* Fix issue returning after save
*14.3.0.28* Fix issue with RNav
*14.3.0.27* Improve handling of SIP devices
*14.3.0.15* Install master files list via installer
*14.2.0.3* Fix module database definition
*14.2.0.3* Fix module database definition
*14.2.0.2* First release of new version without old interface
*13.0.0.1* Packaging of ver 1.0.0.1
*12.0.0.1* Packaging of ver 1.0.0.1
description: SCCP phone management with Cisco built-in VPN and signed provisioning (preview)
